title: CustomerVariables
description: Customer-specific variable estimates and value driver applicability for a given ValueModel. Variable estimates reference an indexed sources registry for traceability. Implementations may extend this schema with additional top-level properties (e.g. market fit, pain points, technical context) provided the core variable, driver, and sources structures are preserved. customer.description: The name of the customer or prospect.

variables.description: Estimated values for each variable defined in the referenced ValueModel. Every estimate must cite at least one source from sources_summary.

value.description: The estimated numeric value of this variable for this customer.

confidence.description: Confidence in the estimate, expressed as a 0–1 score.

sources.description: Integer IDs referencing an optional sources registry. Omit if no source tracking is used.

triangulation_notes.description: Explanation of how this estimate was derived, cross-checked, or triangulated across sources.

value_drivers.description: Applicability assessment for each value driver defined in the referenced ValueModel.

selected.description: True if this driver applies to this customer; false if excluded.

reason.description: Explanation of why this driver was selected or excluded for this customer.

risk_adjustments.description: Adjustments that scale the driver's raw equation output to reflect real-world risk and attribution.

execution_risk.description: Probability (0–1) that the customer will not fully realize this value. Applied as a multiplier: realized_value = equation_value * (1 - execution_risk).

attribution_percentage.description: Percentage of the driver's value attributable to this solution (vs. other factors, initiatives, or vendors). Applied as: attributed_value = realized_value * (attribution_percentage / 100).

justification.description: Narrative explaining the basis for the execution_risk and attribution_percentage values.

sources.description: Integer IDs referencing an optional sources registry. Omit if no source tracking is used.

missing_variables.description: Variables from the ValueModel that could not be estimated, with reasons. Useful for flagging data gaps and guiding discovery conversations.

reason.description: Why this variable could not be estimated.
